purpose: Test whether the frozen layouts have a detectable horizontal rotor-transit geometry difference when vertical exposure is guaranteed by fixing every trajectory at the 150 m hub height.

development_pilot.qualitative_result: The original layout had lower mean hub-height exposure than pareto_032; pareto_037 and pareto_038 were not clearly lower than pareto_032. These pilot data are excluded from the final test.

scenario.height_rule: all trajectories fixed at hub height
scenario.interpretation: controlled maximum-cross-section geometry sensitivity; not an empirical bird-species flight-height model

primary_test.method: two-sided paired Student-t interval across 15 independent common-random-number batches
primary_test.tradeoff_gate: pass only when the interval upper bound is below zero and the original layout AEP is lower than pareto_032 AEP

final_design.secondary_tests: All other pairwise layout comparisons are descriptive and do not receive unadjusted confirmatory claims.

candidates.role: pre-optimisation benchmark and pilot-selected lower-exposure side of the primary comparison
highest-AEP frozen full-run reference and primary comparison baseline

locked_scientific_boundary.unchanged_from_model9: Model 8 horizontal trajectories, meso-response parameters, turbine geometry, rotor-plane heading, FLORIS AEP model and all four layouts
locked_scientific_boundary.changed_for_sensitivity_only: The northern-gannet FHD is replaced by one deterministic height at the rotor centre.
locked_scientific_boundary.excluded_claims: This scenario is not a species prediction, collision probability, fatality estimate or mortality estimate.
